question: Metformin is recommended as initial treatment in most consensus of treatment of type 2 diabetes, for efficacy, safety and price; However, its use has some limitations and it is obligatory to suspend it in some clinical situations. In which of the following situations would you NOT consider stopping this treatment?

options.opa: Introduction of long-acting insulin analogue due to poor metabolic control.
options.opb: Alcohol intake greater than 50 g / day as usual.
options.opd: Diarrheic picture with elevated plasma Cr at 2.5 mg / dL.
options.ope: Acute ischemia of the lower extremities with significant tissue hypoxia.
